patch.value: Adopt current pm-cli extension option contract and toolchain

value.author: codex-toolchain-1114b
value.text: Baseline current pm-cli 2026.11.14 and pm-changelog 2026.11.13 reproduces corpus.test.ts: 7 pass, 7 fail, including all four named scenarios plus containment rechecks, bounded fits and no-git training. GH-1665 normalizes declared spellings to camel-case SDK keys; underscore options are undeclared, so required-option validation precedes the handler. Keep every filesystem refusal and race witness using supported SDK keys; add explicit host refusal/no-write checks. The historical failed CI log also shows required-option message assertions in domain, benchmark, lineage and loop tests; reproduce and adapt those without weakening matchers. Only this tracker item is owned; recursive-training items remain untouched.

value.author: codex-toolchain-1114b
value.text: Installed public SDK declarations in sdk/extension/command-options.d.ts document canonical camel-case keys, direct spelling normalization and required/unknown validation. Two synthetic pm-cli 2026.11.14 probes are upstream candidates, not filed: (1) a missing required flag yields PmCliError with exitCode 2 but code undefined and context {}, so exact message plus absent-code plus no-write witnesses replace handler-message assertions; (2) a declared required fromTracker plus undeclared typo or from_tracker is dispatched with both keys, despite unknown-option refusal being documented. Canonical handler reads ignore those undeclared values and remain correct if a future host refuses them first. Searches for extension required option code and unknown_option harness returned no issues. The npm artifact omits CHANGELOG.md; reviewed the exact v2026.11.14 source changelog through 2026.11.8, including all new Migrate notes. No setup-phase linked tests are added, preserving tracker-reader compatibility.

value.author: codex-toolchain-1114b
value.text:
| Failure | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| corpus exclusive publication handles a real concurrent creator and preserves other IO errors | GH-1665 canonical SDK option keys; underscore-only input fails required-option validation before dispatch | use fromTracker; retain exclusive wx publication, real concurrent creator, ENOENT/ENOTDIR and other IO witnesses |
| corpus missing or invalid directories refuse with stable path-free errors before inventory reads | same host option normalization and required-option precedence | use fromTracker; retain every missing/file/dangling source and parent, stable path-free refusal and preserved bytes |
| corpus output conflicts refuse before source or bounds reads without exposing paths | same required-option precedence | use fromTracker so existing-output refusal executes before source/bounds; retain existing file, dangling link and directory cases |
| corpus output inside the source refuses before inventory reads through relative and symlink aliases | same required-option precedence | use fromTracker; retain all direct, relative and symlink containment refusals with no source/output writes |
| containment rechecks, bounded fits, no-git corpus/intake and public improver building | same unsupported underscore-only SDK keys | use declared fromTracker/fromTrackers; keep real training, bounded reservations, sealed replay and immutable sources |
| domain, benchmark, lineage and loop missing-option expectations | required flags now refuse in the host; missing-option code is absent (upstream candidate) | match exact host text, expected error shape, absent code, exit 2 and unchanged tracker; keep reachable whitespace handler refusals |
| takeover and evaluation SDK option spellings | GH-1665 publishes canonical camel-case SDK keys and folds CLI spellings | use forceTakeover/evaluationCandidate and actual force-takeover spelling; remove underscore fallback reads that real CLI dispatch never supplies |

Validation: corpus 17/17; other focused command checks 10/10; intake 8/8; release approval/calendar 31/31; production and test typechecking, lint, zero duplication across 64 sources, docstrings (572 declarations), publish attestation, identity audit, production audit (zero vulnerabilities), pack dry-run and isolated strict health with required merge drivers pass. Reverting only stringOption in a disposable copy makes the canonical-source regression fail (1/1 fails); restoring it passes (1/1). The four takeover fallback branches were removed because supported CLI dispatch only supplies forceTakeover; both real CLI and SDK spellings remain covered. Required string guards remain reachable via whitespace values and are retained.

Full npm run release:check, bun run release:check and unchanged 100/100/100/100 coverage scope are deferred to CI under the explicit 45-minute local budget: the measured Dependabot npm/Bun jobs took 78/62 minutes. These full local gates were not run and no full coverage certification is claimed. No thresholds, seed counts, deadlines or assertions were lowered; no other tracker item or recursive-training epic was changed. The two upstream candidates are recorded separately and were not filed.
